newsitem.title: USA: Continental promotes Bethune to chairman.
newsitem.headline: Continental promotes Bethune to chairman.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc. Tuesday named Chief Executive Officer Gordon Bethune to the additional post of chairman, succeeding David Bonderman.
Chief Operating Officer Gregory Brenneman, 34, has succeeded Bethune, 55, as president.
Bonderman, whose Air Partners investment group is Continental's largest shareholder, remains chairman of the executive committee and a member of the board, the airline said.
Continental's class A stock fell 12.5 cents to $22 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
